explanation: Weavers in Ecuador plait them from fine toquilla straw. The name stuck in the 1800s, because the hats were shipped through Panama, where travellers crossing the isthmus bought them.

claims.text: The Panama hat originated in Ecuador, where it is woven from toquilla straw.
The Panama hat did not originate in Panama, Cuba or Spain.
Panama hats are plaited by hand from toquilla straw, the fibre of a palm-like plant.
The name Panama hat became established in the 19th century because the hats were shipped through and sold in Panama.
